PP-3, PBR (60 kTPA), MAH, Styrene, NCU phase 2, HDPE-2 upcoming (IOCL Panipat page).
Naphtha cracker: naphtha throughput 2.1 MMT in FY23 (revamp shutdown Sep 2022) vs 3.0 MMT FY22 (AR2223); record 3,111.8 TMT FY24 (AR2324).
